title: TrustManager that does not validate certificates
description: checkServerTrusted with an empty body accepts any certificate, allowing interception (MITM) of TLS connections that use this TrustManager.
remediation: Use the platform's default TrustManager and Network Security Config for pinning or extra CAs.
falsePositives: Dead code or code used only in test builds. Check where the TrustManager is installed (SSLContext.init).

title: HostnameVerifier that always returns true
description: Accepts any host name, defeating the TLS server identity check.

title: onReceivedSslError calls proceed()
description: The WebView keeps loading the page despite a certificate error, allowing MITM.
remediation: Call handler.cancel() (the default behaviour) and do not ignore TLS errors.
falsePositives: proceed() may sit behind a user confirmation or a debug flag; check the body.

title: SSLContext with a legacy protocol
remediation: Use SSLContext.getInstance("TLS") or "TLSv1.3"/"TLSv1.2" and let the platform negotiate.
falsePositives: On Android, "SSL" may negotiate modern versions; the real risk depends on the socket configuration.
